design_doc_scope: Phase 2 — Clone-over-egress capability ONLY (lines 269-556). SUPERSEDED mount design and Phase-1/1b spike records are historical and NOT in scope.
lane: extension (executor-contract widening + executor/eval-harness plumbing); NO AILANG language surface, NO parser/lexer/type-system/motoko-core change; frozen-core boundary holds
execution_environment: isolated git worktree branched from origin/dev (NEVER the shared main working tree); opus sprint-executor; each milestone is one commit; PR into dev; CI + docs build must be green
invariants: RequiresEgress==false default request stays byte-identical to today ({"type":"remote"})
Typed gate: RequiresEgress on a non-CapNetworkEgress executor => loud shared pre-dispatch error before any network I/O (programmatic AND CLI callers)
Clone flags on non-managed_agents or with --api-only => loud CLI error, never ignored
Clone-review with no valid clone evidence => VerificationDegraded with reason; never silently downgraded to prompt-packed, never a clean pass on absent evidence
Deadline expiry => VerificationDegraded with reason; never a silent retry, never a clean pass
All line:number references in the design doc are advisory; locate symbols by name, not line number
Keep the clone preamble in ONE shared builder so M2 (CLI) and M3 (bridge) do not drift

features.description: Task.RequiresEgress bool field + CapNetworkEgress capability constant + shared ValidateTaskCapabilities helper in internal/executor/executor.go; buildEnvironment(task) replaces the envRaw hardcode in internal/executor/managed_agents/managed_agents.go and managed_agents advertises CapNetworkEgress; golden tests assert BOTH JSON shapes and loud non-capability rejection. No live call.
acceptance_criteria: RequiresEgress==false => environment payload byte-identical {"type":"remote"} (golden test, no live call)
RequiresEgress==true => exactly {"type":"remote","network":{"allowlist":[{"domain":"*"}]}} (golden test, no live call)

RequiresEgress set on an executor that does NOT advertise CapNetworkEgress => loud shared pre-dispatch error before any network I/O (unit test with a fake non-capability executor; no Execute/ExecuteStreaming call is made)
ValidateTaskCapabilities with RequiresEgress==false is a no-op (nil error) on any executor
managed_agents Capabilities() includes CapNetworkEgress; package still reads NO Metadata keys

features.description: Register --clone-repo <url> and --clone-sha <sha> in cmd/ailang/exec.go runExec flag block; on success set task.RequiresEgress=true in executeCLI, call ValidateTaskCapabilities before dispatch, and prepend the canonical clone preamble to the directive; loud non-zero exit for non-managed_agents resolution or --api-only, and for --clone-sha without --clone-repo; help text; parsing tests.
acceptance_criteria: ailang exec claude --clone-repo ... (any non-managed_agents resolution) => non-zero exit with a clear error (unit test)
ailang exec gemini --api-only --clone-repo ... => non-zero exit with a clear error (unit test)
--clone-sha without --clone-repo => error
ailang exec gemini --clone-repo ... --clone-sha ... => parses, sets RequiresEgress=true, builds the preamble
ailang exec help updated for the two new flags

features.description: Extend EvalOptions with optional CloneRepoURL + CloneSHA in internal/eval_harness/gemini_evaluator_bridge.go; when set, RunGeminiEvaluator builds the clone-review directive (HEAD: git clone --depth 1; arbitrary SHA: shallow fetch-by-SHA git fetch --depth 1 origin <sha>) instead of packing the full diff; conditional echo-of-rev-parse-HEAD evidence check (pinned => must equal CloneSHA; HEAD => valid non-empty 40-hex, recorded as reviewed revision); deadline-exceeded => VerificationDegraded; unchanged BuildDiffBundle fallback when unset. Verdict return reuses existing text-output parsing (managed_agents_bridge.go unchanged); caller ctx threading unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Clone options unset => BuildDiffBundle fallback path unchanged (regression test)
CloneSHA set and mismatched rev-parse HEAD echo => VerificationDegraded==true with non-empty DegradedReason (fake runner)

HEAD review (CloneSHA empty) with a valid non-empty 40-hex rev-parse HEAD echo => VerificationDegraded==false, echoed SHA recorded as the reviewed revision (positive test — HEAD reviews must pass cleanly)
Either mode with missing/empty/invalid rev-parse HEAD echo => VerificationDegraded==true with non-empty DegradedReason (fake runner)
Fake runner returning a context.DeadlineExceeded-class error => VerificationDegraded==true with non-empty DegradedReason (never a retry, never a clean pass)

Caller ctx honored: the env-builder + clone-review path creates no fresh background context; caller ctx reaches sendInteraction via existing WithTimeout propagation and eval-bridge threading (assertion/unit test)

features.description: Extend the existing managed_agents_live_test.go probe harness (A-R) with an AILANG_LIVE_MANAGED_AGENTS_MOUNT=1-gated (CI-skipped) end-to-end clone->check->verdict run exercising the fetch-by-SHA path to confirm provider support for git fetch --depth 1 <sha>; missing ADC is a SKIP (never a pass). Update ailang exec help + docs guide for --clone-repo/--clone-sha; record the E2E evidence in the design doc.
acceptance_criteria: Live-gated E2E (AILANG_LIVE_MANAGED_AGENTS_MOUNT=1, skipped in default CI; missing ADC is a SKIP, never a pass): sandbox clones the public repo, runs the directive, returns a parsed verdict
fetch-by-SHA provider support confirmed live (or surfaced loudly as a design-doc follow-up if the provider rejects git fetch --depth 1 <sha>; NO silent fallback to full clone)
All tests passing; ailang exec help + docs updated

E2E evidence recorded in design_docs/planned/v0_30_0/m-gemini-repo-mount.md; M4 reported as code+docs done with live run SKIPPED-no-ADC or CONFIRMED-evidence-recorded (never 'passing' on a SKIP alone)

blocks_surfaced: M4 live E2E needs ADC + Vertex spend; if ADC absent in the executor worktree, M4 E2E SKIPs and live confirmation is a hand-off to Mark (do NOT mark M4 passing on a SKIP alone).

fetch-by-SHA (arbitrary-SHA path) is INCORPORATED from the iteration-52 re-quorum, not VERIFIED-LIVE; only --depth 1 HEAD clone was probe-proven (Probe R). M4 E2E is where this single unverified premise gets live confirmation. Low risk (shallow-by-construction).
Preamble single-source: M2 (CLI) and M3 (bridge) both build the clone preamble — keep it in one helper so they cannot drift (planner note, not a doc requirement).
